fullDescription: A high-end surrealist dark mode design system characterized by deep indigo and charcoal tones, editorial serif typography, and floating 3D elements. The style features 'Superdesign' aesthetics, combining glassmorphism with grain textures and heavy scroll-parallax effects. It utilizes a palette of #050505 (Deep Black), #0052cc (Corporate Blue), and #FF4500 (Vivid Orange) for accents. Ideal for elite design agencies, luxury portfolios, high-concept SaaS, and creative studios. Key elements include floating surrealist hand imagery transformed via CSS filters into blue gradients, editorial-style 'Playfair Display' italic headers, and ultra-minimalist 'Inter' UI components.
prompt:
## Resumo
A moody, cinematic web experience designed for high-concept agencies. It features a deep black background (#050505) with atmospheric blue gradients (#0052cc), surrealist floating assets with motion, and a sophisticated pairing of 'Inter' and 'Playfair Display' typography. The layout uses high-contrast negative space and subtle grain overlays to achieve a premium, tactile feel.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with a background of #050505 and a global 5% opacity grain noise overlay (mix-blend-mode: overlay). 
- **Typography**: Headers use 'Playfair Display', font-weight 400-600, tracking-tighter (-0.05em). Body and UI elements use 'Inter', tracking-widest (0.4em for metadata, 0.1em for body). 
- **Colors**: Primary Background #050505; Accent Color #FF4500 (used for small highlights); Gradient Primary #0052cc; Card Background #111111. 
- **Effects**: Use text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.4) for hero headers. Floating assets must use CSS filters: sepia(1) hue-rotate(190deg) saturate(15) brightness(0.8) contrast(1.2) to achieve a blue-chrome effect. 
- **Animations**: Implement 'reveal-on-scroll' with opacity 0 to 1 and translateY(30px to 0px) using cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed header, height transitions from 96px to 64px on scroll. Background: transparent transitioning to #050505/90 with backdrop-blur-xl. Logo on left in monospace; centered links in 10px Inter uppercase tracking-widest; CTA button on right: white pill, black text, font-size 12px.

### Hero Section
Full viewport height. Background: Radial gradient from top-center #0052cc (50% opacity) to #050505. Central text: Playfair Display header, font-size 9xl (128px), color #ffe0e0, mix-blend-overlay. Subtext: max-width 600px, font-size 20px, opacity 70%. Floating assets: Two large PNG hand images positioned absolute (left-top and right-bottom), animated with independent 12s/14s ease-in-out float cycles.

### Expertise/Philosophy Section
Vertical padding: 192px. Center-aligned text. Label: #FF4500, uppercase mono, 12px. H2: Playfair Display, 72px, with italicized keyword emphasis. Logo wall below: 4-column grid, grayscale, 30% opacity, revealing to 60% on hover.

### Works Grid
Two-column asymmetrical grid. Left column cards have a positive Y-parallax (+0.06 scroll ratio); right column cards have a negative Y-parallax (-0.06 scroll ratio). Card design: 48px border-radius, background #111111 or blue-to-black gradient (#1a4d7f to #000000). Height: 5:4 aspect ratio. Content: Icon in top-left, index number in top-right, large Playfair title in bottom-left.

### CTA and Footer
CTA: Giant italic Playfair heading ('Ready to fade?'), font-size 12vw. Underlined email link (#FF4500 hover). Footer: Border-top 1px white/5. Left: Logo and copyright. Right: 'System Operational' status indicator with blinking green #22c55e dot.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### The 'Void' Button — A glassmorphism pill button with an aura-glow interaction.
Component: pill-shaped button. Base: border 1px white/20, bg white/5, backdrop-blur-md. Hover state: border white/40, bg white/10. Animation: absolute positioned div behind button with bg #FF4500/20 and blur-2xl; opacity 0 to 0.7 on hover. Text: uppercase, 12px, tracking 0.3em.

### Chrome Gradient Asset — Transforming standard light-colored assets into themed blue chrome.
Apply to white/silver PNG imagery: filter: sepia(1) hue-rotate(190deg) saturate(15) brightness(0.8) contrast(1.2). This creates a vibrant deep blue tint that matches #0052cc while maintaining texture and lighting from the original image.

## Notas Especiais
Must maintain a strict 'mix-blend-mode: overlay' or 'mix-blend-mode: screen' on hero elements to ensure depth. Do not use standard shadow/light UI patterns; rely on glows and border-colors (rgba(255,255,255,0.05)). Essential to keep the grain noise layer fixed globally for tactile feel. Typography must never use 'regular' weight for UI; always thin/light (300) or bold (600) for contrast.

style.description: The style is 'Dark Surrealism' meets 'Editorial Minimalist'. Typography pairs a clean sans-serif (Inter) for UI/metadata with an elegant, large-scale serif (Playfair Display) for headlines. Colors are dominated by deep blacks and blue glows, with a single high-energy orange accent for critical calls to action. Animations focus on slow, ethereal floating motions and scroll-synchronized parallax displacements.
